name: Unturned
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The free blocky zombie survival game. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with the bundled RocketMod or OpenMod if you want them.
startup: v=; [ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && v=validate; if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $v +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; if [ "{{ROCKETMOD}}" = 1 ]; then [ -e Modules/Rocket.Unturned ] || ln -s ../Extras/Rocket.Unturned Modules/Rocket.Unturned; elif [ -L Modules/Rocket.Unturned ]; then rm Modules/Rocket.Unturned; fi; if [ "{{OPENMOD}}" = 1 ]; then if [ -d Extras/OpenMod.Unturned ]; then [ -e Modules/OpenMod.Unturned ] || ln -s ../Extras/OpenMod.Unturned Modules/OpenMod.Unturned; else echo "OpenMod isn't installed yet: reinstall the server to download it."; fi; elif [ -L Modules/OpenMod.Unturned ]; then rm Modules/OpenMod.Unturned; fi; export TERM=xterm LD_LIBRARY_PATH="./Unturned_Headless_Data/Plugins/x86_64:./linux64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"; log="Logs/Server_{{SRV_ID}}.log"; for try in 1 2 3; do t=$(date '+%F %T'); ./Unturned_Headless.x86_64 -batchmode -nographics -Bind/0.0.0.0 -Port/{{SERVER_PORT}} "-Name/{{SRV_NAME}}" ${SRV_PW:+"-Password/$SRV_PW"} ${GSLT:+"-GSLT/$GSLT"} +InternetServer/{{SRV_ID}}; rc=$?; f=$(grep -a 'Steam can not be initialized' "$log" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | cut -c2-20); { [ -n "$f" ] && ! [[ "$f" < "$t" ]]; } || exit $rc; [ $try = 3 ] && { echo "Steam couldn't start the game server 3 times in a row, so the server stopped."; exit 1; }; echo "Steam couldn't start the game server, which happens now and then; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 3)."; sleep 3; done

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Unturned. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 1110390) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Saves,
# configs and plugins are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-1110390}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# Steam's client library, where Unturned looks for it.
mkdir -p Unturned_Headless_Data/Plugins/x86_64
ln -sfn ../../../steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so Unturned_Headless_Data/Plugins/x86_64/steamclient.so
# OpenMod, the plugin framework whose plugins are NuGet packages. It's kept
# in Extras and linked into Modules at start when OpenMod is on, like the
# bundled RocketMod, so turning it off unloads it. A reinstall updates it.
om=.raptor-openmod
rm -rf "$om" && mkdir -p "$om" Extras
if tag=$(gh-release tag openmod/openmod latest) &&
    gh-release download openmod/openmod "$tag" OpenMod.Unturned.Module.zip "$om/module.zip" &&
    unzip -q "$om/module.zip" -d "$om/out" && [ -f "$om/out/OpenMod.Unturned/OpenMod.Unturned.module" ]; then
    rm -rf Extras/OpenMod.Unturned
    mv "$om/out/OpenMod.Unturned" Extras/OpenMod.Unturned
    echo "Downloaded OpenMod $tag."
else
    echo "Couldn't download OpenMod; the server installs without it. Reinstall to try again."
fi
rm -rf "$om"
echo "Installed Unturned build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Game server token
variables.description: A Steam game server login token for app 304930, which lists the server publicly; empty runs without one.

variables.name: RocketMod
variables.description: Load RocketMod, the plugin framework the game ships with; put plugins in Servers/<server ID>/Rocket/Plugins.

variables.name: OpenMod
variables.description: Load OpenMod, the newer plugin framework; install its plugins from NuGet on the OpenMod plugins page, or with openmod install in the console. It can run beside RocketMod.

variables.name: Server ID
variables.description: The folder in Servers that holds this server's saves and configs.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
